notes.title: Saborus - DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[p][b]🐔 Greetings, chicken-lovers and horror fans!

[/b]We’re thrilled to announce that the free demo of Saborus, the bone-chilling horror adventure where you play as a vulnerable chicken in a deadly slaughterhouse, is available right now on Steam — artfully crafted by High Room Studio and published by QUByte Interactive[b]
[/b]
[b]🌟 Steam Next Fest: June 9–16, 2025[/b]  

Starting today, Saborus joins the Steam Next Fest: June 2025 Edition, running through June 16, 2025. Be sure to wishlist, download the demo, and dive into the livestreams all week long! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3000140/Saborus_Demo/"][/dynamiclink] [b]🐔 Saborus – A Horror Adventure Unlike Any Other[/b]  

Trapped in a sinister slaughterhouse owned by the ominous Saborus corporation, you control a helpless chicken with no weapons — only cunning, stealth, and your beak to solve puzzles and survive. 

Let’s see if you — the bravest of chickens — can survive the horrors of Saborus. Download the demo and remember: in this slaughterhouse, every shadow could mean death.[/p][p]
Don’t miss Saborus in this year’s Steam Next Fest — peck your way through horror and puzzles starting today!lly-altered monstrosities and ruthless workers in this atmospheric terror experience . 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837157/cb330024fdcc4a251cc1a25977404cc0d3e23f2a.jpg"][/img][b]⚠️ What the Demo Includes[/b][/p][list][*][p]A terrifying first chapter in an industrial slaughterhouse.      [/p][/*][*][p]Puzzle-solving with environmental interaction (beak-based mechanics!).      [/p][/*][*][p]High-stakes stealth and chase sequences.      [/p][/*][*][p]Early exploration of disturbing genetic horrors.      [/p][/*][*][p]A gripping taste of the haunting atmosphere.  [/p][/*][/list][p][b]🚀 What’s Coming in the Full Game[/b]      [/p][list][*][p]Expanded slaughterhouse [/p][/*][*][p]featuring new environments and puzzles.      [/p][/*][*][p]Deeper horror encounters, including mutated beasts and hostile workers.      [/p][/*][*][p]Tight stealth mechanics, hide in shadows and evade pursuit.      [/p][/*][*][p]Narrative reveals: uncover Saborus corporation’s dark experiments. [b]HELLO CHICKEN LOVERS![/b]

It’s time to peck at some exciting news! 🐔
We’re thrilled to announce that Saborus is part of the Six One Indie Showcase: Spring 2025!

From May 22 to May 26, you can check out our playable demo on Steam as part of this incredible digital event celebrating indie games from around the world. It’s a fantastic opportunity to explore what it’s like to be a rebellious chicken trying to escape a mysterious farm.

[b]SABORUS DEMO[/b]

Ever wondered what it's like to be a chicken on the run? Well, now’s your chance!

The Saborus demo is live on Steam, available throughout the Six One Indie Showcase.
Get a taste of the action, test the mechanics, and help us by sharing your feedback!

notes.title: Saborus demo and Tokyo Game Show
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837157/45a0018f1ebfd6675d2ce6a7b0e18992dab555fe.jpg[/img]

[b]HELLO CHICKEN LOVERS![/b]

It's been a while since we've updated here, but today we have a lot of information to share with you. Firstly, Saborus will be taking part in the Tokyo Game Show! We're very happy to hear that our game has been selected to take part in one of the biggest events in the world. 

The event starts on September 26 until September 29 and the Saborus stand will be in the Selected Indie section, number A56!

Saborus will be sharing space with many good indie games from many countries, so if you're there, stop by and play the other games too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837157/599ab756e645564efad1b94810162ae9cd67a8de.png[/img]

[b]SABORUS DEMO[/b]

Want to know what it’s like to be a chicken? You can!
We’ve made a demo of the game available to be tested here on Steam!
Take advantage of the opportunity while it's still available to learn more about Saborus and understand the game better!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3000140/Saborus_Demo/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837157/cb330024fdcc4a251cc1a25977404cc0d3e23f2a.jpg[/img]

[b]Follow the adventures in Japan![/b]
 The independent developer from High Room Studio (Jean Lima) took the opportunity to go to Japan to attend the event and has been sharing his experiences on social media. Follow his social medias for more updates!
